chapters.title: Recursive

frames.caption: Recursive — O(n) time, O(h) extra space. Input: inorder(root=tree (1)). Step through to watch the code work on this input.

chapters.title: Iterative, one stack
chapters.code:
def inorder(root):
    out, stack, node = [], [], root
    while stack or node is not None:
        while node is not None:     # descend, remembering the path
            stack.append(node)
            node = node.left
        node = stack.pop()          # leftmost unvisited
        out.append(node.val)
        node = node.right           # its left side is done
    return out
